title: REALITY RELOADED
tagline: ONE GUY. EVERY GAME. TWO CHOICES.
format: 9:16, 61-75 s (over 1 minute for TikTok Creator Rewards), flat 2D cartoon (series/reloaded/engine.html), 60 fps
voting: Exactly TWO options every episode: A and B. Viewers comment A or B, 24 hours. NEVER invent a result: the next episode waits for the real vote count (from #reloaded comment-replies counts or the user).

cast.Jayden: Player 001. 19-22, black hoodie, bleached-blond spiky hair, brown skin (J in engine.html: keep identical). Funny, sarcastic, nervous-confident, modern slang, breaks the fourth wall. Voice: Kokoro am_puck 1.2.
cast.THE SYSTEM: Floating cyan eye-orb with rings. Robotic, mysterious, sometimes sarcastic, sometimes makes things harder on purpose. Announces rules, quests and vote results; knows THE PLAYERS are watching. Voice: bm_george 1.0 + robot effect (speaker 'system').
cast.Player 002: Glitchy red/cyan figure that THE SYSTEM says does not exist. Recurring mystery.

rules: You cannot leave a game until you finish its side quest.
worlds_rule: REAL game names are used (Fortnite, Minecraft, GTA V, Roblox, Call of Duty, FNAF, Rocket League, Among Us...), as fan content. Everything on screen is drawn in OUR style: never copy official characters, skins, logos, UI art or maps; show the game through its gameplay ideas (storm, final circle, blocks, wanted stars, night shift...).

world_ideas.Fortnite: battle royale: bus/blimp drop, storm, final circle
world_ideas.Minecraft: blocky survival: first night, mining, the Nether
world_ideas.GTA V: wanted stars, car chases, missions from strangers
world_ideas.Five Nights at Freddy's: night-shift horror, cameras, survive till 6 AM

mystery_plan: Every 5-10 episodes a big reveal: other trapped players, Player 002, hidden portals, glitches, a rival, a betrayal, why Jayden was selected. Never reveal everything.

mysteries_open: Who is Player 002? THE SYSTEM says he does not exist.

history.title: Selected
history.quest: Reach the final circle without picking up a weapon
history.ending: Final circle reached; boss THE WARDEN appears; escape blimp leaves in 60 seconds. Player 002 seen and vanished.

style: Cinematic 2D (inspired by @yourtrainerarc reels): shot cuts every ~2 s (wide / medium / close-up / reveal), color grade + light rays + rim light, first-person hand shots (scene pov), HUD 'DAY • TIME • GAME', 'RULE #N' line, countdown timer, embers/sparks.
